## What this changes

A short description of the change to the template's structure (a template,
a steering doc, a persona, a `.claude/` skill or hook, a top-level doc).

## Why

What problem this solves, or what gap in the structure it fills.

## Scope check

- [ ] This touches the shared structure (`templates/`, `steering/`,
      `personas/`, `.claude/`, top-level docs), not any one person's
      `your-life/` content.
- [ ] No real personal data is included, even as an example. Fabricated
      examples belong under `examples/`, clearly marked as fiction.
- [ ] If this adds a new template or skill, it follows the shape of an
      existing one in the same directory.

## How you tested it

How you confirmed the change works (ran the skill, walked through the
foundation session, checked the hook fires, etc.).
